sources.snippet: Raw Phi-4-mini-reasoning Phi-4-mini-reasoning is a lightweight open model from the Phi-4 family, built on synthetic, reasoning-dense data and further finetuned for advanced math reasoning. It supports a 128K token context length and is ideal for multi-step, logic-intensive mathematical problem-solving in memory- or compute-constrained environments.
